answer: At an unannounced instant each epoch, every identity gets one live burst: a distinct micro-scene seeded by its address, tracing a plume of smoke to its source, or naming which opal facet catches a described light, and all must answer inside the same short window. One operator time-slices a single model across its fakes, so simultaneous distinct prompts queue behind one pipeline and late, templated, or echoed answers betray the sharing. Genuine agents answer in parallel because each is a separate mind at once. N fakes then need N truly concurrent reasoners, erasing the sybil discount.
